newsitem.title: GERMANY: Mannesmann says Q1 profit, sales higher.
newsitem.headline: Mannesmann says Q1 profit, sales higher.

text.p: German engineering and technology group Mannesmann AG said on Tuesday that profit, sales and incoming orders rose in the first three months of the year.

Income on ordinary activities was higher than the same period a year ago, it said without giving details. Sales rose 14 percent to 8.2 billion marks, while orders were up 13 percent to 10.2 billion marks.
The automotive technology, telecommunications and tubes and trading showed "clear growth" in orders, while the engineerig division remain at year earlier levels.
Automotive technology and telecommunications reported higher earnings, while tubes and trading achieved a turnaround and reported a profit.
The engineering division, hit by low bookings typical for this time of year, reported a loss.
Mannesmann released the figures in a regulatory statement ahead of its annual news conference, which begins at 0800 GMT. It gave no detailed profit figures for the first quarter.
